source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sales strategies (PDF 216-217).

blocks.text: Sales ki hikmat-e-amli gahakon ko khareedne par aamada karti hai: riyayat, promotions aur behtareen khidmat. Ramazan mein Pakistan ki kai grocery dukanein khaas deals deti hain jo zyada khareedari ki hosla afzai karti hain, aur kai karobar Ramazan aur Eid mein, jab log zyada khareedte hain, ishtiharat barhate hain (Did You Know).

blocks.explanation: Riyayat, mehdood waqt ke promotions aur behtareen khidmat.

items: Sales ki tadabeer: riyayat, promotions, khidmat; tehwaron ke mausam ke mutabiq.
